from openpyxl import load_workbook
from datetime import datetime, date
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/57090/1_57090_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/57090_0_f2869ef7/1_57090_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Columns based on the provided sheet layout
project_col = 2  # B: Project ID
shipped_col = 3  # C: Shipped

def get_year(value):
    """Extract a year from Excel date/datetime or common string date values."""
    if isinstance(value, (datetime, date)):
        return value.year
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        # Excel serial dates should already be converted by openpyxl if formatted as dates,
        # so numeric values here are not treated as shipped years.
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).year
        except ValueError:
            pass
    # Fallback: if the string starts with a 4-digit year
    if len(text) >= 4 and text[:4].isdigit():
        return int(text[:4])
    return None

# Build a mapping of shipping year -> set of unique project IDs
projects_by_year = {}
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    project_id = ws.cell(row=row, column=project_col).value
    shipped_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=shipped_col).value
    shipped_year = get_year(shipped_value)
    if project_id is not None and shipped_year is not None:
        projects_by_year.setdefault(shipped_year, set()).add(project_id)

# Fill only G2:K2 with the unique project counts for the year headers in G1:K1
previous_year = None
for col in range(7, 12):  # G through K
    header_value = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
    year = None

    if isinstance(header_value, (int, float)):
        year = int(header_value)
    elif header_value is not None:
        text = str(header_value).strip()
        if text.isdigit():
            year = int(text)

    # If a header has an obvious typo like 221 after 2020, infer the next year.
    if (year is None or year < 1900) and previous_year is not None:
        year = previous_year + 1

    ws.cell(row=2, column=col).value = len(projects_by_year.get(year, set())) if year else 0
    previous_year = year if year else previous_year

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
